# Justin DeMatteis — JUST INNOVATE.

> Justin DeMatteis is a web and mobile developer, product builder, and ecommerce developer based in Ontario, Canada.

## What Justin builds

- Custom web applications and internal business tools
- Shopify and Shopify POS integrations
- Ecommerce workflows and Adobe Commerce / Magento work
- Mobile-first interfaces and product workflows
- Automation and AI-assisted development systems

## Featured work

### JustConsignIn
A Shopify-focused consignment management product created from a real store workflow. It connects consignor intake, inventory, Shopify product creation, POS sales, sale attribution, commission tracking, and payouts.

### Wheels Automotive
Professional B2B ecommerce work involving Adobe Commerce / Magento, frontend implementation, QA, SEO, category and product content, and launch support.

## Development approach

Justin starts with the real workflow and business problem, prototypes the simplest useful solution, connects existing systems where possible, tests against actual use, and keeps refining the product.

AI is used as a development partner for research, architecture, prototyping, coding, debugging, refactoring, documentation, and iteration. Product direction, business understanding, testing, and final decisions remain human-led.
